import json
from work import evaluate
p={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':4,'s':'d'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}
cases=[
 ({'layers':[{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''},'error':None}),
 ({'layers':[{'i':9},{'i':None}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':4,'s':'d'},'error':None}),
 ({'layers':[{'x':1}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'}),
 ({'environment':{'b':'false','i':'-0','s':''}},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''},'error':None}),
 ({'environment':{'b':'False'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
 ({'environment':{'i':'+1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
 ({'environment':{'i':' 1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
 ({'environment':{'i':'1.0'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
 ({'environment':{'i':'1e2'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
 ({'environment':{'i':''}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
 ({'layers':[{'i':True}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}),
 ({'layers':[{'i':'bad'}],'environment':{'i':'7'}},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':7,'s':'d'},'error':None}),
 ({'layers':[{'b':None}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':4,'s':'d'},'error':None}),
]
for n,(request,expected) in enumerate(cases):
 actual=evaluate(request,p)
 assert actual==expected,(n,actual,expected)
 assert set(actual)=={'ok','config','error'}
p2=dict(p, null_resets=False)
assert evaluate({'layers':[{'s':None}]},p2)=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}
p3=dict(p, environment=False)
assert evaluate({'environment':{'x':'1'}},p3)=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}
print(json.dumps({'boundary_cases':len(cases)+2,'status':'passed'}))
